scope.interpretation_summary: The Out Of Home Tea Market encompasses the distribution and sale of tea products consumed outside of the home, including cafes, restaurants, and vending services. Key participants include distributors, wholesalers, resel
scope.market_definition: The Out Of Home Tea Market encompasses the distribution and sale of tea products consumed outside of the home, including cafes, restaurants, and vending services. Key participants include distributors, wholesalers, resellers, system integrators, service providers, and channel partners operating globally.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the logistics and supply chain management of tea products to various out-of-home venues.
This layer includes system integrators who provide solutions for tea service setups in out-of-home environments.

# It makes a proper difference

We go to great lengths to make tea properly – from tasting 1000s of teas a day, to thinking about
the water you’ll brew it with at home. We’ve built close relationships with brilliant tea gardens
which share our love of fairness, flavour and quality, and we trade in a way that respects people
and planet. Why? Because it makes a proper difference.

# People and planet

The future of your brew depends on a healthy planet and decent livelihoods for the people that
produce tea around the world. Find out what we’re doing to make a proper difference through our work
with our suppliers and here in Yorkshire.

# The Teamoji has landed!

The teapot emoji is finally here! From today (6 November 2020) anyone with an iOS or Android device
can start using it.

[ 29.01.20

# The teamoji is coming!

We did it! Tea is finally getting the emoji it deserves – and it’s coming this year. For decades,
all us tea drinkers have had to represent our chosen brew is a little picture of green tea and a
little picture of coffee. And those just don’t cut the mustard when you’re trying to say: “I’m
having a brew.” Where’s the drink we know and love? The proper stuff, the one that’s the colour of
He-Man. You know, tea. So we put a formal application together and sent it to the people who decide
on new emoji – the Unicode Consortium.

Read more

# We've planted 2 million trees!

Five years ago, we set out on a mission to plant one million trees by 2020. With just over month to
go, we're very chuffed to say we've more than doubled that target, planting a grand total of
2,155,067 since 2014.

## Your Trusted Tea Wholesale Supplier 

As premium tea wholesalers, Mello Teas has built a reputation for providing top-quality tea products
to businesses across the U.S. We know that every cup of tea tells a story, and as one of the leading
wholesale tea suppliers in the USA, we are proud to deliver blends that bring comfort, refreshment,
and joy to customers everywhere. 

 

Whether you run a café, retail store, or hotel, having reliable wholesale tea suppliers can make a
huge difference. We offer a wide variety of wholesale bulk tea to fit your needs. From classic black
tea to wholesale herbal tea and specialty blends, we have something for every taste.

## [][30]
## Why Choose Mello Teas as Your Wholesale Tea Supplier?

We are more than just wholesale tea suppliers—we are a trusted partner for businesses looking for
premium, flavorful, and consistent tea. Here’s why we stand out:

 

●     Wide Selection of Premium Teas: We offer a variety of blends, including green, black, herbal,
chai, and more.

●     Reliable Shipping: Fast delivery ensures your stock is always fresh and available when you
need it.

●     Sustainable Sourcing: We prioritize ethically sourced teas to provide a product you can feel
good about selling.

●     Affordable Bulk Pricing: Our wholesale tea supplies come at competitive prices, saving you
money in the long run.

●     Flexible Ordering Options: We offer bulk orders of various sizes to fit your business
requirements, from small cafes to large retail operations.

## [][31]
## What We Offer

### [][32]
### 1. Wholesale Bulk Tea Supplies

As a premium tea wholesaler, Mello Teas provides wholesale bulk tea in large quantities to meet the
needs of businesses that serve tea daily. We understand the importance of quality and consistency
when purchasing in bulk. That's why we take extra care to ensure every batch is perfectly packaged
and ready for use.

 

Some of the bulk tea options we offer include:

 

●     Black Tea: Rich, bold, and full-bodied, black tea is perfect for cafes, restaurants, and
hotels looking to offer a classic tea option. We offer everything from traditional English Breakfast
to Darjeeling and Earl Grey.

●     Green Tea: Light and refreshing, our green tea options are ideal for health-conscious
customers. We provide various types like Sencha, Matcha, and Jasmine Green Tea.

### [][33]
### Herbal Tea: For those who prefer caffeine-free options, we offer a wide range of wholesale
### herbal tea supplies. From chamomile to peppermint and rooibos, our herbal teas are great for
### wellness-focused businesses. 

### [][34]
### 2. Premium Tea Wholesaler: Our Selection

Our role as a premium tea wholesaler is to offer a selection that suits every palate and business
type. Whether you're serving high-end blends in a boutique or everyday favorites in a diner, our

# It makes a proper difference

We go to great lengths to make tea properly – from tasting 1000s of teas a day, to thinking about
the water you’ll brew it with at home. We’ve built close relationships with brilliant tea gardens
which share our love of fairness, flavour and quality, and we trade in a way that respects people
and planet. Why? Because it makes a proper difference.

# The Teamoji has landed!

The teapot emoji is finally here! From today (6 November 2020) anyone with an iOS or Android device
can start using it.

# The teamoji is coming!

We did it! Tea is finally getting the emoji it deserves – and it’s coming this year. For decades,
all us tea drinkers have had to represent our chosen brew is a little picture of green tea and a
little picture of coffee. And those just don’t cut the mustard when you’re trying to say: “I’m
having a brew.” Where’s the drink we know and love? The proper stuff, the one that’s the colour of
He-Man. You know, tea. So we put a formal application together and sent it to the people who decide
on new emoji – the Unicode Consortium.

go, we're very chuffed to say we've more than doubled that target, planting a grand total of
2,155,067 since 2014.

# It makes a proper difference

We go to great lengths to make tea properly – from tasting 1000s of teas a day, to thinking about
the water you’ll brew it with at home. We’ve built close relationships with brilliant tea gardens
which share our love of fairness, flavour and quality, and we trade in a way that respects people
and planet. Why? Because it makes a proper difference.

# The teamoji is coming!

We did it! Tea is finally getting the emoji it deserves – and it’s coming this year. For decades,
all us tea drinkers have had to represent our chosen brew is a little picture of green tea and a
little picture of coffee. And those just don’t cut the mustard when you’re trying to say: “I’m
having a brew.” Where’s the drink we know and love? The proper stuff, the one that’s the colour of
He-Man. You know, tea. So we put a formal application together and sent it to the people who decide
on new emoji – the Unicode Consortium.

**About Us**
Buske Logistics is a privately owned and operated third-party logistics (3PL) warehousing business
founded in 1923. Since 2009, the company has undergone a significant transformation, with Fortune
1,000 standards being implemented under the ownership of S.C. Johnson & Son, Inc. from 2009 to 2015.

New and enhanced systems, processes, and people development have been priorities under the current
management team, which acquired the company in 2015. Most recently, we have accelerated our capital

### **Tastes like Milo’s.**

For more than 80 years, we’ve followed the philosophy of our founders, Milo and Bea Carlton, who
believed in doing things the right way and never sacrificing taste.

Milo’s beverages are 100% natural and still family-made. No short cuts. No nonsense. Just sweet
simple goodness. So grab a jug and pour a glass, or two, or eight, and invite your favorite people
to the table for a delicious homemade taste that’s made even better when you share it.

Tastes like a good day, tastes like Milo’s.

### **Tastes like Milo’s.**

For more than 80 years, we’ve followed the philosophy of our founders, Milo and Bea Carlton, who
believed in doing things the right way and never sacrificing taste.

Milo’s beverages are 100% natural and still family-made. No short cuts. No nonsense. Just sweet
simple goodness. So grab a jug and pour a glass, or two, or eight, and invite your favorite people
to the table for a delicious homemade taste that’s made even better when you share it.

Tastes like a good day, tastes like Milo’s.

their own information they’ve collected about you. Turning off the personalized advertising setting
won’t stop you from seeing Etsy ads, but it may make the ads you see less relevant or more
repetitive.

Personalized advertising may be considered a “sale” or “sharing” of information under California and
other state privacy laws, and you may have a right to opt out. Turning off personalized advertising

Harris Tea fosters strong, direct buyer-grower relationships that yield a wealth of benefits to both
parties - and ultimately to foodservice operators.

## Sourcing

Our dedicated sourcing team and sourcing strategy help us to maintain a continuous, high-quality
supply of delicious tea blends.

## Foodservice Customers

Our tea experts, proactive account managers and our customer support specialists, help our customers
do more than just sell beverages.

## Sustainability

Harris Tea Foodservice is fully committed to making tea production more sustainable, protecting the
environment, improving the lives of everyone in the tea supply chain, and contributing to the
betterment of society at large.

supply to service, from on-trend products to profitability, Harris Tea Foodservice is here to help

Through experience, relationships and innovation, Harris Tea Foodservice delivers a better and more
profitable foodservice beverage experience. Our customers count on us to provide delicious,
high-quality tea products consistently and reliably. Contact us to learn more about our tea brands.

# From Field to Glass

## Growing/Processing

Harris Tea fosters strong, direct buyer-grower relationships that yield a wealth of benefits to both
parties - and ultimately to foodservice operators.

## Sourcing

Our dedicated sourcing team and sourcing strategy help us to maintain a continuous, high-quality
supply of delicious tea blends.

## Foodservice Customers

Our tea experts, proactive account managers and our customer support specialists, help our customers
do more than just sell beverages.

## Product Categories

## Sustainability

Harris Tea Foodservice is fully committed to making tea production more sustainable, protecting the
environment, improving the lives of everyone in the tea supply chain, and contributing to the
betterment of society at large.

 

 

 

 

 

 

### Enhance your beverage offerings with our teas

Let experts from Harris Tea assist you with your foodservice beverage program. From consistent
supply to service, from on-trend products to profitability, Harris Tea Foodservice is here to help
you enhance your tea brands.

### Grow with us

Through experience, relationships and innovation, Harris Tea Foodservice delivers a better and more
profitable foodservice beverage experience. Our customers count on us to provide delicious,
high-quality tea products consistently and reliably. Contact us to learn more about our tea brands.

## Преимущества

### Компания IMKONEX имеет ряд весомых преимуществ перед конкурентами

Представительство в Китае в г. Гуанчжоу, который является транспортным центром всего южного Китая.
В нашей базе сотни проверенных фабрик и поставщиков, мы готовы делиться своими наработками
и организовать для Вас поставки товара из Китая.
Мы осуществляем полное сопровождение сделки. От размещения заказа до его получения.
Все процессы сервиса подготовлены для компаний разного уровня. Мы работаем быстро и эффективно,
обеспечивая нашим клиентам максимально удобный сервис!
Долгосрочные партнёрские отношения с надёжными логистическими компаниями мира.
Много лет мы сотрудничаем с логистическими компаниями, осуществляющими хранение и транспортировку
товаров по всему миру. Важнейшим критерием сотрудничества для нас является их надёжность, это
обеспечивает безопасную, бесперебойную и своевременную доставку Ваших товаров!

С 2009 г.**** **Компания** **IMKONEX** предоставляет профессиональный сервис по организации
и осуществлению внешнеэкономической деятельности на Российских предприятиях. Наш сервис позволяет
компаниям существенно сократить расходы, освободить время для ведения своей основной деятельности,
без труда осуществлять экспортные поставки и развивать новые рынки сбыта.
15 лет мы успешно осуществляем экспортные поставки товаров из России в страны СНГ, Европы и Азии.
Обеспечиваем поставки в Россию импортных товаров из Китая и Европы. Нами накоплен уникальный опыт
в сфере внешнеторговых операций. В арсенале компании большое количество выполненных проектов.
Мы не останавливаемся на достигнутом и готовы поделится этими знаниями с Вами!

**Работаем в интересах своих партнёров и только в правовом поле.**

Желаете расширить область деятельности, осуществлять экспортно-импортные операции, иметь свой отдел
ВЭД, но без обременений и лишних затрат, развивать бизнес не отвлекаясь на непрофильные задачи? Или
Вы планируете построить бизнес с Россией, приобретать продукцию Российских предприятий, снизить
расходы и быть уверенными в порядочности поставщиков? Вы не случайно оказались на нашем сайте.
Присоединяйтесь, неважно крупная у Вас компания или Вы только начинаете свою деятельность, мы будем
рады видеть Вас в числе наших партнёров.

**Вы можете рассчитывать на нас!**
Добро пожаловать в мир внешнеторговых операций!

FAQ

### Where is KW suspensions headquartered?

KW suspensions has its headquarters in Fichtenberg (Baden-Württemberg, Germany), together with other
well-known coilover suspension manufacturers such as [ST suspensions][12] and [ap
Sportfahrwerke][13] as well as the wheel manufacturer [BBS][14]. KW suspensions and all the other
manufacturers mentioned are subordinate to [KW automotive][15], which employs over 400 people in

# Payments, tax & subscriptions for software companies

Selling digital downloads, subscriptions, and software licenses has never been easier, faster, or
more secure.

[
Get started
][32]

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## Lemon Squeezy is the all-in-one platform for running your SaaS business. Payments, subscriptions,
## global tax compliance, fraud prevention, multi-currency support, failed payment recovery, PayPal
## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

01

### Global tax compliance

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**
without you lifting a finger.

02

### Borderless SaaS payments

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept
payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.

03

### Instant payment methods

Our no-code and API solutions **support 20+ payment methods**, and we offer bank payouts globally.

04

### Local currency support

Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**. Lemon Squeezy
currency support spans 130+ countries.

05

### A.I. fraud prevention

Using real-time AI to detect anomalous patterns across signups, logins, refunds, and other actions,
**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

### Failed payment recovery

Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from
subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

ecommerce

## Create the perfect buying experience for your customers

Launch your secure ecommerce website and start selling software, subscriptions and digital downloads
anywhere in minutes. **Utilize no-code checkout links** without worrying about design, mobile
optimization, or payment integrations. It really is easy-peasy.

[
e/1

### Accept online payments

Don't worry about merchant accounts and billing logic. **Choose per seat, usage-based and more**.
Customize as little or as much as you like.

][33][
e/2

Charge customers on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. **Manage upgrades, downgrades, and
cancels**. Offer free trials, discounts, and more.

][34][
e/3

### License key management

Automatically issue license keys for your software and apps after each sale. **Deactivate, re-issue,
and have full control** over license management.

][35][
e/4

Anyone can provide download links, but what about security and abuse? Your **download links are
securely signed**, throttled, and more.

][36][
e/5

### No-code checkout forms

No matter what you use for your website, you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique
checkout links** and sell anywhere.

][37][
e/6

### Launch your ecommerce store

Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**. Customizable, SSL secured
and mobile-optimized as standard.

Grow your audience, build long-lasting customer relationships, and make more sales with **powerful,
easy-to-use marketing tools**. Whether you need to offer discount codes or you want to build your
email list, you can do it all with Lemon Squeezy.

Combining e-commerce and email marketing gives you context to finally **send emails like you know

## Manufacturing Assemblies Intelligently, On Time, and at a Quality Level that Will Exceed our
## Customers' Expectations

### Highest Standards in Quality

At Out of the Box Manufacturing, we drive our processes to foster a culture of creativity and
continuous improvement. The OBMFG Team is committed to meeting or exceeding our customer’s
expectations by providing a quality product at a competitive price with consistent on-time delivery.

We commit to complying with regulatory requirements, to maintain the quality management system and
to utilize regularly reviewed quality objectives to help us achieve these goals. Our list of
certifications and compliances include:
* ISO 9001 AS9100 Registration
* Certificate of Conformance
* ITAR Registered
* RoHS/WEEE Compliant
* IPC610E Compliant
* ISO 13485 Compliant
* J-STD-001 Including Space Addendum
* J-STD-001 In-house Operators
* Certified to IPC J-STD 001H and ANSI/ESD S20.20-2021

### Thinking Out of the Box

Innovation remains the hallmark of everything we do at Out of the Box Manufacturing. This approach
enables us to develop improved methods that save our customers time and money. These methods
include:
* Paperless assembly documentation
* Design for manufacturability reports
* Attentive customer service
* Barcode tracking and traceability
* Automated electronic assembly process
* Innovative Tooling and Fixturing
* Lean culture with a focus on Continuous Improvement

### Intelligent Manufacturing That Exceeds Expectations

Out of the Box Manufacturing offers our customers an innovative approach to component assembly
designed to manufacture the highest quality, most dependable products that will meet your needs and
exceed your expectations. Whether small or large quantity, simple or densely populated; we offer
turnkey options for everything in order to build a complete product. With a detailed understanding
of the electronic assembly industry, our team at Out of the Box Manufacturing has the hands-on
knowledge required to reliably complete any project on time and to your exact specifications. That's
why Out of the Box Manufacturing remains an industry leader in providing exceptional electronic
assembly, service and repair, and box build services.

[ Hands on Service > ][18]

### Meeting Your Electronics Manufacturing Needs

Out of the Box Manufacturing specializes in working with businesses of all sizes and in a variety of
industries. From small start-ups to large OEMs, consumer electronic developers to medical device
inventors, or the aerospace to instrumentation industries; our team of experienced electronic
assembly professionals can satisfy the requirements of any business in need of a versatile contract
manufacturer. Contact us today to learn how Out of the Box Manufacturing is the right component
assembly service provider for your business.

[ Industry Leaders > ][19]

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.

## Welcome toSri Lanka Tea Board

Welcome to the official website of the Sri Lanka Tea Board - the apex regulatory and administrative
body of the Sri Lankan Tea Industry.

The Sri Lanka Tea Board comprises representatives from both private and government bodies involved
in the industry, including cultivators and manufacturers, traders, exporters and plantation
employees. We act as the catalyst of growth for Ceylon Tea, the country’s principal and most popular
export, by facilitating trade and business, propagation and creating awareness, encouraging research
and innovation, and by supporting the creation of a forward thinking and progressive national policy
framework.

**About Us**
Buske Logistics is a privately owned and operated third-party logistics (3PL) warehousing business
founded in 1923. Since 2009, the company has undergone a significant transformation, with Fortune
1,000 standards being implemented under the ownership of S.C. Johnson & Son, Inc. from 2009 to 2015.

New and enhanced systems, processes, and people development have been priorities under the current
management team, which acquired the company in 2015. Most recently, we have accelerated our capital
investments through a partnership with Fourshore Partners in March of 2022.

We are a global company providing a wide array of best-in-class logistics services to Fortune 500
clients in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. Since our inception, we have been committed to offering our
partners the kind of personal attention that results in quick answers, superior value, cutting-edge
technology, and the most reliable performance in our industry.

## **42 Locations**

[Image of Buske's 30 locations across the U.S. and Canada]

## **Our History**

Our 100+ year history in the warehousing and logistics industry, combined with our ever-evolving
innovation and technological capabilities, keeps us firmly planted as a preeminent 3PL organization.

Since day one, we’ve fulfilled the most demanding needs of Fortune 1,000 companies across various
industries, from food and beverage to automotive manufacturing.

### **Tastes like Milo’s.**

For more than 80 years, we’ve followed the philosophy of our founders, Milo and Bea Carlton, who
believed in doing things the right way and never sacrificing taste.

Milo’s beverages are 100% natural and still family-made. No short cuts. No nonsense. Just sweet
simple goodness. So grab a jug and pour a glass, or two, or eight, and invite your favorite people
to the table for a delicious homemade taste that’s made even better when you share it.

Tastes like a good day, tastes like Milo’s.

# From Field to Glass

## Growing/Processing

Harris Tea fosters strong, direct buyer-grower relationships that yield a wealth of benefits to both
parties - and ultimately to foodservice operators.

## Sourcing

Our dedicated sourcing team and sourcing strategy help us to maintain a continuous, high-quality
supply of delicious tea blends.

## Foodservice Customers

Our tea experts, proactive account managers and our customer support specialists, help our customers
do more than just sell beverages.

## Product Categories

## Sustainability

Harris Tea Foodservice is fully committed to making tea production more sustainable, protecting the
environment, improving the lives of everyone in the tea supply chain, and contributing to the
betterment of society at large.

 

 

 

 

 

 

### Enhance your beverage offerings with our teas

Let experts from Harris Tea assist you with your foodservice beverage program. From consistent
supply to service, from on-trend products to profitability, Harris Tea Foodservice is here to help
you enhance your tea brands.

### Grow with us

Through experience, relationships and innovation, Harris Tea Foodservice delivers a better and more
profitable foodservice beverage experience. Our customers count on us to provide delicious,
high-quality tea products consistently and reliably. Contact us to learn more about our tea brands.

без труда осуществлять экспортные поставки и развивать новые рынки сбыта.

FAQ

KW suspensions has its headquarters in Fichtenberg (Baden-Württemberg, Germany), together with other
well-known coilover suspension manufacturers such as [ST suspensions][12] and [ap
Sportfahrwerke][13] as well as the wheel manufacturer [BBS][14]. KW suspensions and all the other
manufacturers mentioned are subordinate to [KW automotive][15], which employs over 400 people in
Fichtenberg.

about the special features of our Coilover suspensions or read about why an upgrade with KW
suspensions products is worthwhile for your specific vehicle model in our [KW suspensions vehicle
world][16]. Once you have decided which product is right for you, you can easily purchase it via our
[KW suspensions online shop][17].

## **About Us**

At Outdoor Living Supply (OLS), our mission is to build a nationwide network of leading
distributors, focused on outdoor living. We utilize a multipronged growth strategy which includes
cultivating enduring partnerships with top industry manufacturers. We maintain an obsessive,
customer-first focus. We believe in leading with technology and innovation – to reinvent the
contractor experience.

# Australia's Most Trusted Two Way Radios & Walkie Talkies

Radio Warehouse supply only Australia's** most trusted **& **proven, **walkie talkies, two way
radios, professional UHF radios and other team communication systems for **business, government &
enterprise clients.**

We are** fully authorised dealers** **& resellers **of: [**Icom**][169]**, **[**Kenwood**][170]**,
**[**Motorola**][171]**, **[**Tait**][172]**, **[**Wireless Pacific**][173]**, **[**GME**][174]**,
**[**3M Peltor**][175]**, **[**Hytera**][176]**, L3Harris, Sepura, Savox & [**Simoco.**][177]**

Our solution consultants earn **0% sales commission**, and provide **independent, expert advice**
about what radio system may suit your mission. Every radio system sold comes with **complete**
nationwide **comprehensive** after sales & technical support.

We ship our two-way radio solutions to clients located in **Melbourne**, **Sydney**, **Brisbane**,
**Adelaide**, **Canberra**, **Gold Coast**, **Cairns**, **Hobart**, **Perth**, **Darwin**, and
**Alice Springs**. We also supply some products into a growing list of international regions,
including **New Zealand** and **Papua New Guinea**.

Whether you're a large international retailer, a growing SME business, or perhaps a Federal, State
or Local government agency, we have the capabilities to serve you. 

For nearly 20 years, Radio Warehouse has proudly supported thousands of Australian organisations
with **proven**, **cost-effective**, **"turn-key" radio communication solutions** that deliver
**commercial & government-grade **performance**,** your team can trust, when it matters most.

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.

## Tea Drinkers Want Love Too!

**Still "satisfying" your tea customers with a stale teabag or something they could buy in any
grocery store? Why not turn them into an evangelist of your business? Read on below to learn more
about how we can help you thrill your customers....**

[ Learn More][8]
Looking for our retail site? We're at **[www.DominionTea.com][9]**
[ [Wholesale tea available including single estate and blends.] ][10]

## [Bulk Tea][11]

We source great tea and produce a wide variety of small-batch artisan tea blends. Our strong focus
on sourcing only what we can use in a short time ensures you get the freshest teas possible.
Packaged in reasonably sized resealable packages.

[Learn More][12]
[ [Packaged-Tea-For-Resale] ][13]

## [Retail Label Tea][14]

Any of our retail packaged teas can be purchased for resale at wholesale pricing. Package sizes are
2 oz, 4 oz, and 8 oz with distinctive blue stand-up pouches. Small minimum order requirements allow
you to test the waters with minimal risk.

[Learn More][15]
[ [Wholesale bulk teas and blends available in private label packaging.] ][16]

## [Private Label Tea][17]

Want something distinctive for your business? We can package tea with your own private label design
in 2 oz, 4 oz, and 8 oz sizes. Small minimum order requirements allow you to offer private label
packaged tea with low investment.

[Learn More][18]

**Looking for corporate or wedding gifts? We're happy to help with these too. [Learn more about our
options][19].**

### Wholesale Tea for Your Business

You've built a business around offering customers the best experience. Your [coffee shop][20] may
have the best small-batch roasted coffee imported from the world over. Perhaps its your tea shop or
café that has awesome food and atmosphere. Or perhaps your [restaurant][21] has the freshest food
prepared with exquisite care, the best pampered [spa experience][22], or a great [yoga studio][23]
with highly trained instructors with great personalities. And then there is the tea you offer. What
does that odd assortment of tea bags of questionable vintage say about your tea loving guests?

Turn your tea loving guests into loyal customers by providing them an experience that shows you
truly care. A high quality, loose leaf tea program barely takes any time or training for your staff
but speaks volumes to your customers. Let us show you how!

We've got a great variety of teas from which to choose at wholesale prices. We can supply all the
(minimal) equipment you would need, and quick training guides to ensure your staff are prepared to
offer customers a great experience. Our wholesale customers benefit from no minimum order
requirements (apart from a minimum $200 first order), easy ordering, order histories, and training!

[Ready to get started? Look over our FAQ and request a wholesale account if we can help you
grow.][24]

[Loose Leaf Wholesale for Restaurants and Coffee Shops]

### Next Steps... Frequently Asked Questions

Our goal is to support your long term success and we've learned a thing or two about what works for
our customers. You will find those insights in the [Wholesale FAQ][25]. When you are ready, request
a wholesale account so you can place your first order and gain access to tips, tricks, and job aids
to ensure that you and your team have the knowledge and expertise to delight your customers.

### Wholesale Tea for Your Business

You've built a business around offering customers the best experience. Your [coffee shop][20] may
have the best small-batch roasted coffee imported from the world over. Perhaps its your tea shop or
café that has awesome food and atmosphere. Or perhaps your [restaurant][21] has the freshest food
prepared with exquisite care, the best pampered [spa experience][22], or a great [yoga studio][23]
with highly trained instructors with great personalities. And then there is the tea you offer. What
does that odd assortment of tea bags of questionable vintage say about your tea loving guests?

Turn your tea loving guests into loyal customers by providing them an experience that shows you
truly care. A high quality, loose leaf tea program barely takes any time or training for your staff
but speaks volumes to your customers. Let us show you how!

We've got a great variety of teas from which to choose at wholesale prices. We can supply all the
(minimal) equipment you would need, and quick training guides to ensure your staff are prepared to
offer customers a great experience. Our wholesale customers benefit from no minimum order
requirements (apart from a minimum $200 first order), easy ordering, order histories, and training!

[Ready to get started? Look over our FAQ and request a wholesale account if we can help you
grow.][24]

[Loose Leaf Wholesale for Restaurants and Coffee Shops]

### Next Steps... Frequently Asked Questions

Our goal is to support your long term success and we've learned a thing or two about what works for
our customers. You will find those insights in the [Wholesale FAQ][25]. When you are ready, request
a wholesale account so you can place your first order and gain access to tips, tricks, and job aids
to ensure that you and your team have the knowledge and expertise to delight your customers.
